title: Yi nazarin kamfanin fintech kuma ku tsara kwanaki 90 na gaba
course_title: Mahimman Fintech: Yadda Kuɗin Dijital ke Aiki a Afirka

say: Yi nazarin kamfani na fintech, kuma ku tsara kwanaki 90 na gaba.
Wannan shine bidiyon don ƙirar uku na Fintech Fundamentals.
Ko kuna son aiki a fintech, kuna son tuntuɓar ɗaya, ko amfani da ɗayan a cikin kasuwancin ku, kuna buƙatar fahimtar kamfani cikin sauri da daidai.

say: Fara da amfani da samfurin. Bude asusun ajiyar kuɗi, lura da wane nau'i ne yake nema, kuma ku yi ƙaramin aiki guda ɗaya, kamar siyan naira 100 na lokacin iska. Karanta sake dubawa na kantin sayar da kayan aiki na baya-bayan nan kuma sanya gunaguni.

say: Misali, Funmi tana da hira a app na tanadi. Ta buɗe asusun ajiya na asali kuma ta lura da samfuran: ajiyar kuɗi mai sauƙi, kulle kulle da asusun dala.

say: A cikin sharuddan ta sami bankin abokin tarayya mai suna da mai kula da asusu mai suna.

say: Ainihin fintech yana da samfurin bayyananne, bayyanannen hanyar samun kuɗi, da lasisin da zaku iya dubawa.

panel.heading: Real fintech ko Ponzi makirci?
left: Komawa waɗanda zasu iya hawa ko ƙasa
right: An biya daga kuɗin sabbin membobin
Matsin lamba don sake saka hannun jari

say: A gargaɗe ku ta hanyar ƙayyadaddun dawowa na 20% ko fiye a wata, dawowar da aka biya daga kuɗin sababbin membobin, tukuicin ɗaukar ma'aikata, kuma babu rajistar SEC.
MMM daskarewa janyewar kudi a ƙarshen 2016. Tsarin irin wannan haɗari ne don faɗakar da mutane.

say: Misali, wallet yana ba da rahoton masu amfani da rajista 1,000,000. 280,000 ne kawai suka yi amfani da shi a cikin kwanaki 30 na ƙarshe, ƙimar aiki na 28%. Rijista baya aiki.

panel.heading: Abin da ainihin masu amfani miliyan 1 ke nufi
items: Adadin kuɗi: kudaden shiga / TPV = 0.8%
CAC: Naira 500 ga kowane sabon mai amfani
Bayarwa: 500/40 = watanni 12.5
Adadin NPL: 45 na miliyan 500 = 9%

say: Adadin ɗauka shine raba kudaden shiga ta jimlar ƙimar biyan kuɗi, ko TPV. A nan kashi 0.8 ne, abin da kamfani ke samu a kowace Naira da aka sarrafa.

Adadin NPL: 45 na miliyan 500 = 9%

say: Ya kashe naira miliyan 6 don samun masu amfani da aiki 12,000, CAC na naira 500 kowanne. Kowanne yana samun Naira 40 a wata, don haka biyan bashin yana ɗaukar watanni 12.5.

say: Sunan manufa ɗaya, kamar jami'in cibiyar sadarwa na wakili a kamfanin biyan kuɗi. Maye gurbin sha'awar fintech tare da hujja, kamar binciken da kuka haɗa.

panel.heading: Makasudi ɗaya, abubuwan da ake fitarwa kowane wata
items: Sunan damar manufa guda ɗaya
Kwanaki 1 zuwa 30: gama nazarin shari'a da katin ƙira
Kwanaki 31 zuwa 60: buga kuma a tuntubi mutane biyar
Kwanaki 61 zuwa 90: aikace-aikace biyar ko shawarwari biyu
Ranar 90: ƙidaya sakamako kuma daidaita

say: A cikin kwanaki 1 zuwa 30, gama binciken shari'ar ku da katin ƙima. A cikin kwanaki 31 zuwa 60, raba taƙaice kuma ku tambayi mutane biyar a yankin da kuke so takamaiman tambaya ɗaya kowace.

say: Don tunawa. Yi bincike tare da tsarin kuma tabbatar da ainihin lasisi. Yi nisa daga manyan ƙayyadaddun dawowa da ladan daukar ma'aikata. Yi la'akari da lafiya tare da ƴan rabo, ba manyan jimloli ba. Kuma nuna shaidar ilimin ku, ba tare da taɓa sarrafa kuɗin abokin ciniki ba.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Yi amfani da tsarin nazarin shari'ar kashi takwas
Tabbatar da ainihin lasisi
Babban kafaffen dawowa da daukar ma'aikata: Ponzi
Matsakaicin aiki, ƙimar ɗaukar nauyi, CAC, biyan kuɗi, NPL
Nuna hujja; taba rike abokin ciniki kudi

say: Yanzu fara fayil ɗin kamfani na babban dutse tare da tabbataccen lasisi, gina katin ƙima na kamfanin ku tare da tushe, da tsara shirin ku na kwanaki 90.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Fara fayil ɗin kamfani na babban dutse
